identificationModule.briefTitle: Herombopag Treated T-DM1 Induced Platelet Reduction
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Single-arm Exploratory Clinical Study Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of T-DM1 in Patients With Breast Cancer Who Developed Thrombocytopenia.

leadSponsor.name: Sun Yat-Sen Memorial Hospital of Sun Yat-Sen University

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a single-arm study planned to enroll 56 breast cancer patients who experienced grade 2 or higher thrombocytopenia following prior chemotherapy and achieved normalization (platelet count ≥100 × 109/L and ≥200 × 109/L) through intervention.

armGroups.label: Treatment group A
armGroups.description: Herombopag， initial dose 7.5 mg po qd d1-14

primaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of grade I thrombocytopenia according to CTCAE4.0
primaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of patients with platelet counts \<100 × 109/L according to CTCAE4.0
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From enrollment to the end of treatment at 6 weeks

secondaryOutcomes.measure: the proportion of salvage platelet transfusion therapy
secondaryOutcomes.description: Proportion of patients requiring platelet transfusion therapy during treatment
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From enrollment to the end of treatment at 6 weeks

secondaryOutcomes.description: Median time to achieve and maintain platelet counts ≥100 × 109/L from the start of Hetrombopag until the next treatment cycle;
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From enrollment to the end of treatment at 6 weeks

secondaryOutcomes.description: Proportion of patients who experienced delay, dose reduction, or discontinuation of T-DM1 due to thrombocytopenia
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From enrollment to the end of treatment at 6 weeks

secondaryOutcomes.description: According to CTC AE 4.0 to evaluate profile of adverse events
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From enrollment to the end of treatment at 6 weeks
